rationale: B shows sustained, coherent responsiveness and self-directed shifts: reacts to TOUCH at t8 by leaning to PERSON_ALPHA (t8–17), reorients to CALL at t20, focuses on OFFER_FOOD at t32 (t32–41), engages when PLAY_BALL is presented at t44 with extended play-bow/crouch sequences (t44–63), withdraws appropriately to STARTLE at t68 (t68–77) and then spontaneously resumes play (t78–83), remains organized during attention withdrawal (t84–91), and explores PLAY_CUBE late (t94–95).
